issue_context.title: Bug: Right-clicking on images/video files crashes app
issue_context.body:
### Description

Right-clicking on images/video files crashes the app everytime.  This only started happening after I updated on April 21, 2023. Before that, I loved it more. I still love the app. It is great, but I need to tag my photos and am unable to. It seems to work fine on Word and PDF files.

### Steps To Reproduce

Go to any photo or video file
Right Click on it
A spinning blue circle appears
App crashes
Error report message appears
The app restarts on its own

Thank you....

### Requirements

- eg. Fix crash that occurs when...
- eg. Correct action happens when clicking...


### Files Version

2.4.66.0

### Windows Version

Edition	Windows 11 Home Version	22H2 Installed on	‎11/‎4/‎2022 OS build	22621.1555 Experience	Windows Feature Experience Pack 1000.22640.1000.0

### Log file

[debug.log](https://github.com/files-community/Files/files/11302119/debug.log)
